paper_observation_accounting: integer units plus non-negative cash must reconcile to portfolio value
trading_restriction: turnover is permitted only on frozen rebalance observations and must include at least 0.4% charged costs
paper_record_integrity: each checkpoint uses a deterministic SHA-256 chain over the frozen candidate fingerprint and every chronological observation; any rule, value, or order change invalidates the checkpoint
notes: All observations through 2026-07-27 are considered inspected historical data.
Activation opens record-only forward tracking and does not create a historical or synthetic observation.
Any change to weights, instruments, rebalance interval or gates creates a new candidate ID and restarts the forward clock.
Paper tracking does not authorize brokerage access or real orders.
